name: leadlens
displayName: Leadlens — Email Preview & Linting for Adobe Marketo Engage
description: Build and inspect Adobe Marketo Engage Email Editor 2.0 templates and email HTML with local multi-client previews and source-linked linting.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: HTML emails are linted in Restricted Mode. MJML templates are not: compiling one runs the workspace's own mjml package, which is code from the folder you opened.

commands.title: Leadlens: Open Preview to the Side
Leadlens: Preview Component in Marketo Template

leadlens.include.markdownDescription: Glob patterns to lint. Keeps the linter out of HTML that isn't email — set this to e.g. `emails/**/*.html` for a mixed repo.

leadlens.clients.markdownDescription: Client IDs to report on. Empty means all 21. Run `Leadlens: Show Full Report` to see the list.

leadlens.skip.description: Checks to skip. Skipping accessibility also skips dark and mobile contrast. Contrast and targeting checks are general checks, not filtered by selected clients.

leadlens.rules.markdownDescription:
Severity per rule, keyed by the code shown in the Problems panel — a CSS property (`border-radius`) or a rule id (`img-missing-alt`). `off` hides it entirely. Set it in `.leadlensrc` to make it the team's.

```json
{ "border-radius": "error", "font-size": "off" }
```

leadlens.maxOccurrencesPerRule.markdownDescription: A single broken rule can occur in dozens of elements. Underline at most this many of them per rule, so one mistake doesn't fill the Problems panel.

enumDescriptions: Detect Marketo syntax conservatively from the source.
Treat the file as an Email Editor 2.0 template and validate module/container structure.
Treat the file as a complete Marketo email without requiring template structure.
Treat the file as standalone Marketo content and skip whole-email checks.
Treat the file as ordinary HTML and do not resolve Marketo syntax.
leadlens.marketo.context.markdownDescription: How to interpret HTML in this folder. Auto-detection leaves ordinary HTML and other template languages alone; an explicit choice wins when inherited or assembled Marketo HTML is ambiguous.

leadlens.preview.defaultClient.markdownDescription: Client the preview opens on. Run `Leadlens: Show Full Report` to see the IDs.

leadlens.preview.loadRemoteImages.markdownDescription: Load images hosted elsewhere in the preview. **Off by default**: an email's images include its tracking pixels, so previewing one would tell the sender you opened it.

leadlens.resolveStylesheetLinks.markdownDescription: Read local `<link rel="stylesheet">` files and analyse the email with that CSS folded in, reporting findings in the stylesheet itself. The link is still reported separately — email clients drop external stylesheets, so a build step has to inline it before sending.

scripts.test:integration: node clean-integration-output.mjs && node build.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && vscode-test
